name: English
overviewDescription: FileSpacer is a free, open-source Windows file manager that remembers each folder’s window and icon layout. Features, screenshots and downloads.
guideDescription: Learn how to use FileSpacer: folder windows, icon layouts, mouse shortcuts, custom menus and integrations with Windows, Everything and Nilesoft Shell.
changelogDescription: FileSpacer release notes: new features and changes by version.
